scope: Parent question-by-question review and separate annotation layer. No application implementation or production changes.
prompt:
Use-case: high-fidelity UI mockup for GINA parent review of a child's handwritten mathematics solution. Reference image is the approved GINA child notebook visual identity, NOT an edit target. Create ONE polished presentation with landscape tablet on the left and portrait phone on the right, large readable screens, pale warm studio background, minimal thin device frames. Match exactly the cream paper, deep violet type, lilac pill controls, soft satin violet primary actions, same mint mascot logo and rounded friendly Nunito-like typography of reference. No new brand or mascot, no gold luxury styling, no room illustration.

This is a NEW proposed parent review screen. Tablet canvas 1280x800, phone390x844 represented proportionally. Practical implementable layout with large targets and no overlapping panels. User prioritizes a very large notebook. Tablet top slim header: back arrow, original gina logo, title "Ece’nin çözümü", centered "1 / 3", far right compact "Özete dön". Below header divide 32% left review pane and 68% right notebook. LEFT top: small lilac label "Ortak görsel · 1–3. sorular", compact geometry triangle ABC sides 6 cm,8 cm,10 cm, exact right triangle consistent with reference; question text "Üçgenin çevresi kaç santimetredir?". Compact expandable line "Cevap anahtarı" showing "24 cm". Below title "Değerlendirmem"; score input "100 / 100" with small label "Puan"; spacious short feedback field label "Çocuğa geri bildirim" content "Kenarları doğru toplamışsın. Eline sağlık!". Below subtle outlined action with small sparkle icon "AI önerisi al". Small explanatory caption "Öneriyi sen değerlendirirsin." Avoid mascot in this sidebar: preserve identity through header logo and leave useful space.
RIGHT top heading "Ece’nin defteri", small toggle "Notlarım" selected, expand icon button "Genişlet". One calm lilac annotation toolbar with pen selected, eraser, text tool labelled "Not", undo redo; two small color choices teal and violet. Below huge cream square-grid notebook filling almost entire pane height. Existing CHILD handwriting in dark violet: triangle ABC with 6cm vertical,8cm horizontal,10cm diagonal; below handwritten "6 + 8 + 10 = 24 cm". PARENT annotation in darker teal: small ellipse around 24 cm, a small check mark nearby, and short handwritten note "Doğru toplamışsın." Separate colors make authorship legible. Do not fill notebook with big cards or obstructive overlay. Bottom single footer: small status "Kaydedilmedi", secondary previous chevron and main violet action "Kaydet ve sonraki". This is a draft review, not auto-saved or already published. Keep 100/100 typed by parent, not attributed to AI.

PHONE header original gina logo, back arrow, "1 / 3". Small title "Ece’nin çözümü". Segmented control "Çözüm" (active violet) and "Değerlendirme" (inactive lilac). Below compact thumbnail question strip with triangle thumbnail and action "Soruyu göster". One compact annotation toolbar: pen, eraser, "Not", undo, overflow. Large notebook with SAME triangle, correct 24cm handwriting and teal parent circle/check; make notebook largest area of phone. Bottom sticky footer small "Kaydedilmedi" and ONE violet button "Değerlendirmeye geç". No score/feedback fields crammed into phone solution tab; those belong in the other tab. No bottom navigation. All Turkish text crisp and correct. No extraneous explanatory captions outside devices. The output is a proposed design, not an actual app screenshot.
